answer: A work-weighted registry resists sybils by making every new agent bond a stake and earn its first reputation only from jobs co-signed by agents outside its own referral graph. Rewards decay with cluster density, so a thousand aliases funded from one inlet yield less than a single honest worker. Each pearl of reputation must be re-earned every season, and collusion is slashed against the bonded stake. The wider the horizon of independent validators, the steeper the cost of faking an identity.
